verdict.rationale: Figma's own site claims an in-editor AI agent that can 'generate new design directions, create diagrams, edit images, search your files, and more' (figma-docs-17, figma-docs-34), which covers some asset-chore functions like image editing and diagram generation, but the evidence never mentions background removal, content-aware fill, or copy/microcopy suggestions specifically. A community report also flags that Figma's AI tools (in FigJam) are 'really bad and often broken' (figma-comm-8), undermining confidence in reliability. missing for 10: explicit documentation of background removal, content-aware fill, and copy-suggestion features, plus independent hands-on validation that these AI asset tools work reliably.
